g.text: Forward streamlines of the accepted stationary CFD field

path.style: fill: none; stroke: #000000; stroke-width: 0.8; stroke-linejoin: miter; stroke-linecap: square

g.text: B6 | Actual clot points, local streamlines and flow direction
Streamlines integrate the native P1 velocity field; arrow direction follows that field.
Rigid geometry and steady water flow: these are not microbubble streaming, detached-fragment trajectories or two-way FSI.
